_comment: Config vendor-mode (physical transfer of skills to the repo). Copy to the target project as .swissknifeman/config.json. Source of truth: the rules below unfold into a flat set, sync copies skills from the library swissknifeman in skills_path and writes skills-lock.json (managed). Command: skiller sync [--dry-run]. $schema gives autocompletion in the editor.
_comment_mode: only for now vendor (physical transfer + lock)
_comment_skills_path: where to copy; default .claude/skills (Claude finds automatically)
_comment_include: specific skills from any area: 'bucket/rel' or simply 'name'
_comment_exclude: subtraction from (buckets ∪ include): skill name or 'bucket/rel'
